investment_strategy: Barbell within AI: overweight resilient mega-cap platforms with strong fundamentals and positive analyst support (MSFT, GOOGL) and a smaller, high-conviction allocation to the AI compute leader (NVDA). Given VIX ~23 and 10Y ~4.3%, size risk conservatively, favor balance-sheet strength and diversified revenue, and keep the highest-volatility name as a minority position. Focus on durable AI monetization (cloud, enterprise tools, ad platforms) and the essential picks-and-shovels driving AI compute. Implement with staged entries (e.g., 2-4 tranches over 3-6 weeks) to reduce timing risk and rebalance quarterly or if a single name exceeds 55% of portfolio.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Resilient AI platforms plus risk-managed exposure to AI compute

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility, strong fundamental growth, positive momentum, and supportive analyst consensus. Tilted toward mega-cap platforms with diversified cash flows and added a limited AI compute leader. De-prioritized higher-volatility names with weaker momentum or heavier China/regulatory exposure (e.g., META’s mixed momentum, AMZN/AAPL bearish trends, MU/ASML/QCOM/INTC higher volatility or cyclical/export risks).
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive long-term on AI infrastructure and platforms, but near-term volatility is elevated (VIX ~23) and 10Y ~4.3% can pressure multiples. Expect continued investment in chips, memory, and data centers, with regulatory scrutiny and China controls as key watch items. Favor mega-cap platforms and selective picks-and-shovels with disciplined sizing.
